<noinclude>
This is the "Safety Incident" form.

To create a page with this form, enter the page name below;
if a page with that name already exists, you will be sent to a form to edit that page.

{{#forminput:form=Safety Incident|autocomplete on category=Safety Incident}}
</noinclude>
<includeonly>
<div id="wikiPreview" style="display: none; padding-bottom: 25px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid #AAAAAA;"></div>

{{{for template|Safety Incident}}}

{| class="formtable"
|-
! Incident Title:
| {{{field|title|mandatory|input type=text|size=80}}}
|-
! Incident Date:
| {{{field|date|mandatory|input type=date}}}
|-
! Incident Type:
| {{{field|type|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Chemical Spill,Fire,Injury,Equipment Failure,Electrical,Other}}}
|-
! Severity:
| {{{field|severity|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Minor,Moderate,Major,Critical}}}
|-
! Location:
| {{{field|location|mandatory|input type=combobox|values from category=Lab Room|autocomplete on property=Room Number}}}
|-
! Equipment Involved:
| {{{field|equipment_involved|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Equipment|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Personnel Involved:
| {{{field|personnel_involved|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Personnel|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Protocol Involved:
| {{{field|protocol_involved|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Protocol|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Description:
| {{{field|description|mandatory|input type=textarea|rows=5}}}
|-
! Resolution:
| {{{field|resolution|input type=textarea|rows=5}}}
|-
! Follow-up Actions:
| {{{field|follow_up_actions|input type=textarea|rows=5}}}
|-
! Status:
| {{{field|status|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Open,Under Investigation,Closed|default=Open}}}
|-
! Reported By:
| {{{field|reported_by|mandatory|input type=combobox|values from category=Personnel|autocomplete on property=Personnel Role}}}
|}

{{{end template}}}

'''Free text:'''

{{{standard input|free text|rows=10}}}
</includeonly>
